The thermometers shall be on the height, that it is convenient to read them (ca 1,3 – 1,8m at the bottom level of transformer). Thermometer shall have maximum temperature indicating pointer with resetting possibility. Thermometer shall fit for remote measurement (4…20 mA floating DC signal). The thermometer shall have an extra oil-filled thermometer pocket for remote reading of top-oil temperature, excluding the instruments themselves.
